mapper.select: select o.order_id, o.delivery_id, o.customer_id, c.route_id, r.route_name, c.name as customer_name, c.alias as customer_alias, c.phone as customer_phone, c.map_location, c.longitude, c.latitude, c.map_address, o.previous_debt_amount, o.total_amount, o.receivable_amount, o.received_amount, o.repayment_amount, o.unpaid_amount, o.remark from biz_customer_order o left join biz_customer c on o.customer_id = c.customer_id left join biz_route r on c.route_id = r.route_id where o.delivery_id = #{deliveryId} order by o.order_id
